meaning:
1) gird, encompass, equip, clothe
1a) (Qal) to gird, gird on (metaphorical of strength)
1b) (Niphal) be girded
1c)(Piel) hold close, clasp
1d) (Hiphpael) gird oneself (for war)

renderings.bsb: I will equip you for battle

elsewhere.note: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”
My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
